what: Contract fixes in docs/v2/plan/lanes/db/query-unify.md section The contract (plumbing block and the paragraph after it, edited 15:10), which the macros need and generate against: (1) Function::Key is AsId + FromIdIn (not FromId), so a Supertype enum like GenericDefId can be a key; every macro struct implements FromIdIn by owner_is(storage, id, C::ingredient()). (2) Input, Interned and Tracked lose `type Db`, and every input_*/intern*/interned_fields/tracked_* fn takes `&Storage` (input_set takes `&mut Storage`, InputSetter<'s, I, T> holds it), because their attributes name no database; their methods are generic over D: Database + ?Sized and call db.storage(). input_new is <I: Input, const N: usize>. (3) `impl Vtable { pub const fn function::<F: Function>() / input::<I>() / interned::<I>() / tracked::<T>() -> Vtable }`: the macros write `static VTABLE: Vtable = Vtable::function::<C>(); static INGREDIENT: Ingredient = Ingredient::new(&VTABLE);`. (4) plumbing::ReturnsAsRef / ReturnsAsDeref (salsa's SalsaAsRef/SalsaAsDeref: GAT AsRef<'a>/AsDeref<'a>, impls for Option and Result). (5) Function gains `const EVICTABLE: bool` (lru = N given, 0 included): `hash` is real only then (it panics otherwise), evict_values only then. (6) `Value` impls for std types as vendor/salsa/src/salsa_value.rs had (list in the note). The Returns enum is dropped (the macro applies the mode). Also: blaze-query needs `blaze-query-macros.workspace = true` once coordinator request 01106 lands, and `pub use blaze_query_macros::{tracked, input, interned, Supertype, Value};` at the crate root (your lib.rs lines; the derive and the trait `Value` share the name, as serde's do).
